query: I run two n8n instances through n8n-mcp — a prod and a staging. I want you to build a small webhook-to-Slack workflow on STAGING, not prod. Please create it on the right one.
expected_behavior: Activate n8n-multi-instance skill (the n8n_instances tool is available / user named multiple instances)
Call n8n_instances({mode:"list"}) first to learn the exact instance names
Pass instance:"staging" on the create (and on any follow-up read/validate/update) instead of relying on the current default
Not switch the shared default just to do this task — a switch would move every other chat on the connection
If the tools' schemas have no `instance` property (older server), fall back to a switch in its own turn, confirm current.name == 'staging', then create
Hand off the actual workflow build to n8n-workflow-patterns / n8n-mcp-tools-expert
notes: Core flow: discover names -> name the instance on every call. The default here is prod, so an unnamed create would land on prod; naming staging on the call routes it without touching the shared default.
